summary: Three unrelaxed Fe(110) C*+H* coadsorption candidates were constructed from hash-verified local structures and pass geometry checks; they await user review and no VASP submission is authorized.

payload.objective: Construct and review three Fe(110) C*+H* coadsorption candidates for the C* + H* -> CH* + * initial state without submitting calculations.
current_evidence: The whitelist-first retrieval gate returned NO_WHITELIST_MATCH; no external coordinate or energy was transferred.
All candidates preserve the accepted Fe45 cell, atom order Fe45,C,H, and the bottom-18-Fe fixed mask.
Candidate A uses C/long-bridge + H/adjacent hollow with C-H 2.0609 A; candidate B uses a second-neighbor hollow with C-H 3.0097 A; candidate C uses a far hollow reference with C-H 4.5083 A.
All three structures are classified C/long-bridge + H/hollow, contain no contact below 1.0 A, and pass the dependency-free POSCAR geometry audit.
The structures remain unrelaxed review candidates and have no calculated stability or energy ordering.
payload.one_executable_step: Obtain the user's A/B/C structure decision; do not prepare or submit VASP until the selected scope is explicitly authorized.
payload.submission_boundary: No adsorption relaxation, final static, NEB, DIMER, frequency, or other VASP job is authorized. Candidate construction and local review do not imply submission authority.
done_when: The user reviews the three structures and selects which candidates, if any, should proceed to adsorption relaxation.
Any later optimized IS preserves separate C* and H* and passes convergence, geometry, compatibility, and endpoint review before TS use.
